subject: biology
why: All four points with the umbilical vein/artery named.
lines: Yes, this is valid, because the fetus's own gut, lungs and kidneys are not working yet.
Small intestine role: soluble nutrients (glucose, amino acids) diffuse from the maternal blood across the placenta into the fetal blood.
Lung role: oxygen diffuses from the maternal blood into the fetal blood and reaches the fetus through the umbilical vein,
while carbon dioxide arrives from the fetus in the umbilical artery and diffuses across into the maternal blood.
Kidney role: urea in the umbilical artery diffuses from the fetal blood across the placenta into the mother's blood, so her kidneys can excrete it.

subject: biology
why: All scheme points: replaced as fast as used; swallowed and blocks gut; not decomposed, accumulates in soil; named hormone oestrogen + fewer gametes/lower fertility.
lines: (a) A resource that is replenished at least as fast as we use it, so it does not run out and is still available for future generations.
(b)(i) Turtles and fish swallow plastic bags, thinking they are food; the plastic cannot be digested and blocks their gut, so they cannot feed and starve to death.
(b)(ii) Decomposers cannot break plastic down, so it builds up in the soil and landfills, reducing soil aeration and quality.
(c) The toxins lower the production of oestrogen.
With less oestrogen, ovulation is reduced so fewer eggs (gametes) are released, fertility falls and fewer offspring are born.

subject: biology
why: Gives all six creditable points; max 4.
lines: Thermoreceptors in the skin of his right leg detect the heat and nerve impulses are produced.
The impulses travel along a sensory neurone to the spinal cord.
In the grey matter of the spinal cord they pass to relay neurones, which carry impulses up to the brain.
The brain interprets the impulses, so Robin feels that the object is hot.
Relay neurones also pass impulses across a synapse to motor neurones, but these are damaged, so no impulses reach the leg muscles and they do not contract - his leg does not move.

lines: The adrenal glands release adrenaline into the blood.
The adrenaline is carried in the bloodstream to the leg muscles to tell them the object is hot, but the leg is paralysed so the hormone cannot reach it.
